en.summary: This commit fixes an L2 SourceD control predicate so final flush hints are not misrouted into the dirty-data path by an over-broad miss condition.
why_it_counts: SourceD.scala rewrites the key condition that decides whether a dirty line must enter the bank-store read path.
The commit message explicitly calls out an operator-priority issue.
The changed predicate controls L2 cache state progression, not test infrastructure.
disqualifiers: scoreboard.scala only adds dontTouch debug markers.
evidence: SourceD.scala changes the condition that sends the request into stage_3 for dirty handling.
The io.d.valid hunk only adds parentheses and does not materially change behavior.

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: SourceD dirty miss and hint stage_3 entry predicate
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: Restore the old dirty-handling predicate in the stage_1 branch of SourceD.scala.
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Final flush or hint operations on dirty lines take the wrong dirty-data path, causing extra bank-store access or wrong response sequencing.
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache controller often needs different behavior for dirty misses versus flush or hint traffic. If the dirty-data-path predicate is grouped too broadly, a final flush or hint transaction can be mistaken for a normal dirty miss and forced through an unnecessary data-read or writeback sequence.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: dirty miss versus flush-hint path selection
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A dirty cache-control request is a terminal flush/hint transaction.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Fold hint traffic back into the generic !hit dirty-miss branch by removing the explicit Hint exclusion.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: broaden control predicate due to wrong grouping
portability_notes: Use this on any cache controller with separate dirty-data and flush/hint subpaths.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the state transition that sends a dirty request into a readback or victim-writeback path.
Remove the opcode exclusion that keeps terminal flush/hint traffic out of that path.
Trigger with a dirty line and a final flush/hint request.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: stage_1 predicate selecting stage_3 dirty-data handling
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes the stage_3-entry predicate so Hint requests only use the dirty-data path for non-final flush hints.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: At the when-condition under read-hit-or-miss-dirty handling, change ((!hit && opcode=/=Hint) || (Hint && !last_flush)) back to the broader older form.

evidence_for_injection: SourceD has a separate path for Hint && last_flush, proving final flush should bypass the general dirty-miss path.
The scoreboard changes in the same commit are debug-only dontTouch additions.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L2 SourceD 的控制谓词，使最终 flush hint 不会再因为过宽的 miss 条件而被错误送入 dirty-data 路径。
why_it_counts: SourceD.scala 重写了决定脏块是否进入 bank-store 读取路径的关键条件。
提交信息明确指出是运算符优先级问题。
该谓词控制的是 L2 cache 状态推进，而不是测试基础设施。
disqualifiers: scoreboard.scala 只增加了 dontTouch 调试标记。
evidence: SourceD.scala 修改了把请求送入 stage_3 进行脏块处理的条件。
io.d.valid 那一处改动只是补括号，没有实质行为变化。
scoreboard.scala 的修改仅用于调试可观察性。

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: SourceD 中脏块 miss 和 hint 进入 stage_3 的判定条件
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: 把 SourceD.scala 中 stage_1 分支里的脏块处理谓词恢复为旧版本。
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: dirty line 上的最终 flush 或 hint 会走错 dirty-data 路径，导致额外 bank-store 访问或响应次序错误。
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: cache 控制器通常需要对 dirty miss 和 flush/hint 流量采用不同路径。如果 dirty-data 路径的谓词分组过宽，那么最终 flush 或 hint 事务就可能被误判成普通 dirty miss，被送入不必要的数据读取或回写序列。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: dirty miss 与 flush-hint 路径选择
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个 dirty cache 控制请求是终止型 flush/hint 事务。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除对 Hint 的显式排除，使 hint 流量重新落入通用 !hit dirty-miss 分支。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 因错误分组而放宽控制谓词
portability_notes: 可映射到任何把 dirty-data 路径与 flush/hint 路径分开的 cache 控制器。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到决定 dirty 请求是否进入 readback 或 victim-writeback 路径的状态转移。
移除把终止型 flush/hint 挡在该路径之外的 opcode 排除条件。
用 dirty line 上的最终 flush/hint 事务触发。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: stage_1 中选择 stage_3 dirty-data 处理的谓词
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复修改了进入 stage_3 的谓词，使 Hint 请求只有在非最终 flush hint 时才走 dirty-data 路径。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 read-hit-or-miss-dirty 相关的 when 条件里，把 ((!hit && opcode=/=Hint) || (Hint && !last_flush)) 改回旧的更宽形式。

evidence_for_injection: SourceD 对 Hint && last_flush 有单独路径，说明最终 flush 本应绕开通用 dirty-miss 路径。
同提交里的 scoreboard 改动只是调试用 dontTouch。
